title: Rooftop Relay
tagline: Two taps, one skyline, zero room for a missed gap.
description: Sprint across a city of laundry lines, AC units, and neon signs. Pick the safest lane at the last second and hold the streak through three weather patterns.
prompt: Build a self-contained browser game called Rooftop Relay. Sprint across a city of laundry lines, AC units, and neon signs. Pick the safest lane at the last second and hold the streak through three weather patterns.
